evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: Content-fingerprinting music search is not duplicated elsewhere; other music discovery stories differ by profile, metadata, or video input.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Profile-based search is distinct from similar-user search and recommendation stories.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Similar-user music search differs meaningfully from own-profile search and general content recommendations.

evaluations.evidence: music or ringback tones similar to a given music video based on content similarity
evaluations.rationale: Video-based similarity and ringback tone discovery differs from audio fingerprinting and other music search stories.

evaluations.evidence: enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Metadata/image-tag music discovery is distinct from content-fingerprinting, profile, and similar-user stories.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps
evaluations.rationale: Uploading and making tags available is a distinct processing requirement.

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: Thumbnail sequence viewing is not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Substantially duplicated by ZO-009; ZO-009 covers the same actor, goal, and object with only the qualifier 'perceptually', which does not create a meaningful difference.

evaluations.evidence: perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Substantially contained in ZO-008; same actor, goal, and object without meaningful difference in context or business rule.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: General content recommendation from similar profiles is distinct from music-specific profile search.

evaluations.evidence: content recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: News-event-based recommendation is distinct in context and goal.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos
evaluations.rationale: Person identification differs meaningfully from product, logo, and brand identification.

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos
evaluations.rationale: Product identification differs meaningfully from person, broadcaster logo, and brand identification.

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos
evaluations.rationale: Broadcaster-logo identification is a distinct recognition target.

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos
evaluations.rationale: Brand identification is a distinct recognition target with its own business rule.

evaluations.evidence: take a picture or upload an image, so that I am recommended with videos related
evaluations.rationale: Image-to-video recommendation is distinct from other discovery and recommendation stories.

evaluations.evidence: walk around, access content using a geographical map
evaluations.rationale: Map-based content access is unique in context and goal.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: ASR-based content search is distinct from other search mechanisms.

evaluations.evidence: see, validate and edit segmentation of videos
evaluations.rationale: Admin segmentation validation/editing differs from other video analysis and annotation stories.

evaluations.evidence: annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment
evaluations.rationale: Annotation and topic extraction are distinct from segmentation editing and other admin tasks.

evaluations.evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects
evaluations.rationale: A/V quality filtering is distinct from nudity, copyright, and asset-information prefilters.

evaluations.evidence: quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload
evaluations.rationale: Audio-edit assessment is unique among admin content checks.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter nudity content
evaluations.rationale: Nudity prefiltering is a distinct content filter.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter content using search based on low-level asset information
evaluations.rationale: Low-level asset search is distinct from high-level metadata/tag search.

evaluations.evidence: automatically validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement
evaluations.rationale: Copyright validation is distinct from other prefilter and quality checks.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter the content using search on high-level asset information such as metadata and tags
evaluations.rationale: High-level metadata/tag search is distinct from low-level asset search.

evaluations.evidence: assess how interesting or appealing or complex a picture is
evaluations.rationale: Picture interestingness assessment differs from scientist-prompting and other admin analytics.

evaluations.evidence: detect when a scientist should be prompted to look at a subject
evaluations.rationale: Scientist-prompt detection is distinct from image interestingness assessment.

evaluations.evidence: identify volunteer types
evaluations.rationale: Volunteer-type identification differs from volunteer classification weighting and recommendation.

evaluations.evidence: preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low-level image features
evaluations.rationale: Galaxy Zoo preclassification is project- and task-specific.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals
evaluations.rationale: Snapshot Serengeti animal-absence detection is distinct from Plankton Portal absence detection by domain and object.

evaluations.evidence: automatic image series detection for the case of timestamping malfunction in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Timestamp-malfunction series detection is unique in context and goal.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti is distinct from attribute and count detection in the same project.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal attribute preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Attribute preclassification differs from species, count, and series detection.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal number detection in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Animal-count detection is distinct from species and attribute preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: automatic segmentation or localization of plankton in Plankton Portal
evaluations.rationale: Plankton localization is distinct from other Plankton Portal tasks.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton
evaluations.rationale: Plankton-absence detection is distinct by domain and object from Snapshot Serengeti animal-absence detection.

evaluations.evidence: automatic detection of plankton size or orientation
evaluations.rationale: Plankton size/orientation detection differs from plankton species and localization tasks.

evaluations.evidence: automatic preclassification of plankton species in Plankton Portal images
evaluations.rationale: Plankton species preclassification is distinct by domain from Snapshot Serengeti species preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: automatic worm motion analysis to reduce video duration in Worm Watch Lab
evaluations.rationale: Worm motion analysis differs from egg-laying time detection.

evaluations.evidence: detect the time in a Worm Watch Lab video where the worm lays an egg
evaluations.rationale: Egg-laying detection is distinct from motion-analysis duration reduction.

evaluations.evidence: detect important features such as areas of flooding, damage, temporary shelters, blocked roads
evaluations.rationale: Satellite feature detection is distinct from other image-analysis stories.

evaluations.evidence: assess the probability/weight of a volunteer's classification based on their experience
evaluations.rationale: Volunteer classification weighting differs from volunteer-type identification and project recommendation.

evaluations.evidence: prefiltering of the images to remove artefacts such as bright stars and camera read errors
evaluations.rationale: Artefact removal is distinct from moving-object detection and other image tasks.

evaluations.evidence: detect moving and transient objects in the images
evaluations.rationale: Moving/transient object detection is distinct from artefact removal.

evaluations.evidence: remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files
evaluations.rationale: Audio noise removal is distinct from whale-call grouping and counting.

evaluations.evidence: group whale calls that are similar
evaluations.rationale: Whale-call grouping is distinct from subject grouping by similarity and whale counting.

evaluations.evidence: identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file
evaluations.rationale: Whale count estimation is distinct from whale-call grouping.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should interrupt a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Interruption timing is distinct from education timing and modality decisions.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Interruption modality is distinct from education modality and interruption timing.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should educate a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Education timing differs from interruption timing.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Education modality differs from interruption modality.

evaluations.evidence: know which piece of education I should give to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Specific education selection differs from timing and modality decisions.

evaluations.evidence: know when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Volunteer comment detection differs from Zoonibot commenting and explanation stories.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Zoonibot commenting differs from explanation and from volunteer comment detection.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should give an explanation
evaluations.rationale: Explanation timing differs from commenting and explanation content.

evaluations.evidence: know what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Explanation content is distinct from timing decisions.

evaluations.evidence: group subjects by similarity
evaluations.rationale: Subject similarity grouping is distinct from whale-call grouping and other clustering tasks.

evaluations.evidence: recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences
evaluations.rationale: Admin-oriented project recommendation is distinct from user content recommendation.

evaluations.evidence: see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them
evaluations.rationale: Article summarization is unique in the backlog.
